description.value:
Whose it was. Madame Orsolya Fiorn, a Taldan performer who thought she could out-dazzle Celmak. Celmak has been wearing it on her stand-ins. She is very upset to see it go.

Use the standard rules for a robe of scintillating colors (Core Rulebook).

From the hoard of the fallen, sorted by owner and labelled in Celmak's neat handwriting.
